verdict.rationale: The docs name concrete biometric defenses. Motion liveness asks users to complete a head-turn pattern or four randomized head movements. Known Faces flags faces that have already been through your verification flow, catching repeat fraud attempts. However, nothing in the pack explicitly addresses AI-generated faces, deepfakes or camera/video injection attacks. missing for 10: named deepfake/synthetic-face detection, camera or virtual-device injection-attack detection, technical documentation of how liveness resists digital (non-presentation) attacks, independent testing or certification evidence.
